sequence.description: The log's head once the command committed: its last event, or the head it saw when it appended none.

changed.description: False for a command that was accepted and changed nothing, so appended no event.

sequence.description: The log's head when the command was rejected.

reason.description: Why the command was rejected, the code of its error: not_found when its target does not exist.

code.description: A stable error code in snake case.

error.description: The rejection as an error: its code (the reason), a message for people and structured data.

receipt.description: A command's receipt: accepted (with the head sequence after it and whether it changed anything) or rejected (with the reason and the error). A retry with the same commandId answers the same receipt.

result.description: The method's result, present when this request applied the command; absent on a retry and on a rejection.

id.description: A terminal's id: a version 4 UUID the opening client mints, unique on the environment and never reused, kept in lowercase.

owner.description: A tool terminal: the Managed tools registry's, listed under no session.

sessionId.description: Null: a tool terminal names no session.

openedAt.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

cols.description: A terminal's width in columns, 1 to 1,000.

rows.description: A terminal's height in rows, 1 to 1,000.

exitCode.description: The shell's exit code once it has exited; null while it runs.

signal.description: The signal that ended the shell, when one did; null otherwise or while it runs.

terminal.description: A tool terminal: one install or update command the Managed tools registry runs through the user's login shell.

tool.description: The tool installed or updated: bao for vault's Install.

action.description: What tools.run does: install (a tool not installed), update (one installed by a method the harness drives; for one it does not, as terminal) or terminal (the vendor's documented command, run in the tool terminal once a person presses Enter there); a Copy row runs nothing.

method.description: A way the harness installs or updates a tool: homebrew; winget; apt or dnf, the vendor's repository added with its signing key; script, the vendor's install script (claude's native installer among them); npm, a global package; scoop, mise or asdf, the package manager's own upgrade of the package the tool was installed as; manual, a binary placed by hand, updated by the vendor's self-update or, for bao, its release archive checked against the published checksums. Only the first five install; the others only update.

command.description: The command line the login shell runs, each argument quoted as one word.

anyOf.description: How a tool was installed: homebrew (a Cellar or Caskroom), winget (WinGet's packages or links), scoop, mise, asdf, npm (a node_modules path), native (claude's native installer, its versions directory), apt (a package dpkg owns), dnf (a package rpm owns), manual (nothing claims it) or unknown (the package owner could not be asked).

method.description: The install method doctor reports, in the registry's words (native; npm-global and npm-local as npm; a package manager's homebrew, winget, mise, asdf, deb as apt and rpm as dnf; unknown), to set beside the row's detected one: doctor misreports it on ordinary machines. Null when its words map to none of them (a development build, pacman, apk).

name.description: The field's name, as doctor printed it: Running, Path, Config install method, Auto-updates, ...

value.description: Its value, as doctor printed it.

items.description: One field of doctor's summary: its name and its value, as printed.

fields.description: Its summary's fields, in the order it printed them.

issue.description: What doctor found, as it printed it.

fix.description: The fix it suggests; null when it gives none.

items.description: A warning doctor found, and the fix it suggests.

warnings.description: The warnings it found, in its order; empty when it found no installation issue.

oneOf.description: doctor ran and its summary was read.

reason.description: Why nothing was read: it gave no answer in time, exited with an error, or printed no summary; scrubbed.

oneOf.description: doctor ran, and nothing could be read from it.
The tool is not installed, so nothing ran.

anyOf.description: What a tool's doctor said: its fields, the install method it reports and its warnings; that it failed; or that the tool is not installed.

doctor.description: For Update on claude, what claude doctor said before the command ran, to set beside the method the row detected, which the run used; null otherwise.
